newsitem.title: CHINA: China to seek international aid for quake-hit area.
newsitem.headline: China to seek international aid for quake-hit area.

text.p: China appealed on Thursday for international aid to help to rebuild an area of the northwestern Xinjiang region that has been devastated by six major earthquakes this year.
The Ministry of Civil Affairs will ask the international community for aid to rebuild towns in Jiashi county destroyed by the series of earthquakes, state radio said.
The Ministry of Civil Affairs had received an allocation of 15 million yuan ($1.8 million) and 200 tents from the Finance Ministry to aid victims of the earthquakes in Jiashi, state radio addeed.
"The Ministry will notify the international community of the conditions in the disaster area and details of relief work and will seek assistance," it said.
The latest earthquake to jolt Jiashi, measuring 6.3 on the Richter scale, struck the region early on Wednesday, destroying more buildings in the area and seriously injuring one person.
More than 4,000 tremors and aftershocks have jolted Jiashi since a major earthquake in January.
